nodes.label: Joint multi-division solve (shape B)
nodes.rationale: All selected divisions' movable fixtures in a single AI run; sequential orchestration and a hierarchical meta-pass were rejected. Divisions sharing courts are handled defensively today (siblings appear as immovable obstacles) but never optimized jointly. Joint officials stays out of scope.

nodes.label: buildCompetitionPack
nodes.rationale: Union of the selected divisions' packs with every fixture and slot tagged division_id. Courts are division-scoped text labels with no FK, so cross-division court identity is a string name match — divergent labels get a board warning, and a venue-level court entity is separate future work. Cap is checked before any credit reserve.

nodes.label: quoteRun batch discount: credits = max(1, Σ rungs − 1)
nodes.rationale: The budget is sized from the UNDISCOUNTED rung total, not from credits charged: two joint rung-1 divisions would otherwise get half the budget they get run separately. The batch discount is a margin gift, not a capability cut, so pricing and budget are decoupled. The division path calls the same function with one line, so there is no second pricing code path to keep in sync.

nodes.label: divisionIds.length ≥ 2 required
nodes.rationale: Prevents discount arbitrage: a single rung-2/3 division would otherwise run cheaper through the board (max(1, rung−1)) than through the division flow.

nodes.label: R15 correction — no proposal-recall capability exists
nodes.rationale: The ai-last endpoint assumed the division flow persists a proposal for later recall; it does not — lastAiApply returns the last APPLIED plan. A propose-only run writes down its price and usage, never its plan, and the live proposal stays in board client state. Returning a partial plan response was rejected because it publishes a shape into the public OpenAPI spec that a later task would have to breaking-change.

nodes.label: Atomic joint apply (all divisions or nothing)
nodes.rationale: One transaction writes all divisions or nothing — no partial competition apply. Repair-round validation runs validateAssignments over all selected divisions jointly so cross-division double-booking is caught in-run, not at apply. An invalid division 422s naming the division, before any reserve.

nodes.label: 500 movable-fixture cap (block over cap)
nodes.rationale: Refuse with 'too large — schedule per division'. No silent fallback and no cap raise; auto-chunking is explicitly out of scope. The cap also bounds the COGS ceiling of an undiscounted joint budget.
